name: L&T Kanchipuram hyperscale data center
notes: L&T official MoU states 90 MW data centers and associated units in phased development over five years at Kanchipuram; third-party listing identifies LNT Chennai CHN 1 / L&T Vyoma at Kanchipuram. Capacity recorded as announced full build; operational status inferred from public facility listing.

name: L&T Data Centre Expansion Project in Kancheepuram
notes: ETInfra reports a Tamil Nadu government-L&T MoU whose largest component is a data centre expansion project in Kancheepuram district involving INR 15,000 crore investment and about 500 jobs; capacity not disclosed.

name: Betterworks AI data centre investment in Kanchipuram
notes: Guidance Tamil Nadu / InvestTN social post says an MoU was exchanged with Betterworks (USA) for AI data centre investment in Kanchipuram, with INR 5,000 crore investment and 1,450 jobs; capacity not stated.

name: Thiagarajar College of Engineering Data Center
notes: Institutional campus data center established in 2011 at TCE; page describes app, database and compute-cluster consolidation, about eight racks, 250 KVA generator and 30 KVA UPS. Not a hyperscale/colo project.
